method: Post-hoc frozen-artifact audit. No LLM requests or causal model refits. Oracle lookup diagnostics use training-fold oracle effects only and are not deployable causal estimators.

initial_ontology.measurement_definition: Extract the numerical percentage value of PD-L1 expression (Tumor Proportion Score/TPS) from the pretreatment pathology or molecular report. If only a threshold or category is provided, extract the reported threshold (e.g., '<1%' as 1, '>=50%' as 50) or the categorical range bounds if specified.

final_ontology.measurement_definition: Extract the reported PD-L1 expression category (Tumor Proportion Score/TPS). Common categories include '< 1%', '1-49%', and '≥ 50%'.

llm_decision.cross_method_reconciliation: Strong evidence for effect modification from the R-learner, while univariable confounding evidence is absent.
evidence_for: strong relative r_loss improvement in 3/5 folds (ranks 2, 5, 9)
llm_decision.inner_fold_consistency: Moderate; top-n selected in 3 of 5 folds.
llm_decision.rationale: The feature shows significant evidence of treatment-heterogeneity via the R-learner, despite lacking confounding evidence.
